open_minor_issues.what: When the seed is relocated on tablet/mobile, every other tile keeps its desktop-relative --d, so the staggered paint no longer radiates from the visible seed (it radiates from where the seed used to be). Barely perceptible because most of the wall is covered, but it contradicts the card's mechanic.
open_minor_issues.fix: Either keep the seed in its HTML position on those breakpoints (choose which columns/rows to expose around it instead of moving it), or set per-breakpoint delays with a tiny JS pass that recomputes --d from the seed's rendered grid position on load/resize.
